effects.effect: Whenever a creature within [distance](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/distance) of your [Dramatic Monologue](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-monologue) ability makes a power roll, you can spend 1 drama as a free triggered action to use [Dramatic Monologue](scc:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.troubadour.level-1/dramatic-monologue), targeting only one creature.
